note: Private family-owned RV park near New Cumberland (Hancock Co), ~2.4 mi from Tomlinson Run State Park. Open field setting, not waterfront. Self-contained rigs only. --Claude
summary: Fees $22-36 (2026 rates) confirmed; water/sewer, 22 sites with pull-thrus, no bathroom/shower/laundry confirmed manual; added booking (Firefly online, phone/text). Electric 50A left derived (operator site gives no amperage). Note: dropped the site-count/hookup and facilities restatements.
flags: Long-stay/workforce lean: the site pitches 'Close to local employers', posts weekly and monthly rates, and every Google review quoted on the page is a one- or two-month work stay. Nightly rates are posted and the Firefly portal books nights, so it passes, but it reads as a workforce-leaning park. Presence passes (working site with phone 412-330-1146; Google Maps 5.0 over only 11 reviews).
